final: WITH src AS (SELECT source, SUM(amount) AS s FROM income GROUP BY source), tot AS (SELECT SUM(s) AS t FROM src), paired AS (SELECT src.source, src.s, src.s * 1.0 / tot.t AS r FROM src JOIN tot ON tot.t IS NOT NULL), avgs AS (SELECT AVG(s) AS a FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT paired.s, paired.r, avgs.a FROM paired JOIN avgs ON avgs.a IS NOT NULL WHERE paired.s > avgs.a) SELECT AVG(s) AS avg_kept_sum, AVG(r) AS avg_kept_share, AVG(s - a) AS avg_kept_excess FROM kept
